name: orkestrator
description: Components rendered by the Orkestrator desktop app

components.name: ColumnHistogram
components.description: Draws how the numbers of one column of a TableDataset are distributed, as bars over its range.

props.description: Where the record is written: {"status", "loading", "ready", "failed", "empty", "stale", "error", "data"}. `data` is {"domain": {"min", "max"}, "bins": [counts]}, or null for a column with no numbers. Seed it in demo_state for the preview, which reads nothing.
How many bars. Defaults to 32.
Extra Tailwind classes appended to the element.
Remove the record when this leaves the screen, instead of keeping it marked stale.
The column, by its name. Nothing is read while it is unset.
CSS height of the bars. Defaults to "6rem".
The table, a structure reference ({"object", "__identifier": "@mikro/tabledataset"}): typically `{args.table}`.

components.name: ColumnStat
components.description: Reads how full one column of a TableDataset is and how its numbers spread, in one scan. Draws nothing.

props.description: Where the record is written: {"status", "loading", "ready", "failed", "empty", "stale", "error", "data"}. `data` is {"rows", "nonNull", "min", "max", "mean", "distinct"}; min/max/mean are null for a column with no numbers, distinct is null unless asked for. Seed it in demo_state for the preview, which reads nothing.
Remove the record when this leaves the screen, instead of keeping it marked stale.
The column, by its name. Nothing is read while it is unset.
Also count the distinct values. A full scan of the column: leave it off unless shown.
The table, a structure reference ({"object", "__identifier": "@mikro/tabledataset"}): typically `{args.table}`.

components.name: MikroScene
components.description: One mikro scene and its stores, shared by the MikroScene parts inside it. One per blok is the supported case: a second scene's viewport also hears the window's keyboard.

props.description: Where the selection is written: {"annotation", "lens"} (structure references), or null when nothing is selected.

Where the scene's world coordinate system is written, a structure reference ({"object", "__identifier": "@mikro/coordinatesystem"}), once the scene has loaded. What a picker of what this scene can show asks the server with: `lenses(filters: {placeableIn: {space: $world}})`, `$world` read from this path. It writes a STRING: the local is a STRING, ENUM or DATE port.
Extra Tailwind classes appended to the element.
Follow the scene as others change it, an action writing a layer included. Defaults to true.
Runs when a shape is drawn. event.annotation, event.kind, event.lens and event.descriptors: the shape and the lens under the probe as structure references (lens null when none was under it).

event.description: The drawn shape, as a structure reference.
The lens under the probe, or null.

props.description: Runs when a layer comes, goes or draws another lens. event.layers and event.added; an action here that writes layers is told again, `added` names the new ones.
Runs on a deliberate click that reads a voxel (probe mode, not a vertex being placed). event.layer, event.world, event.voxel and event.lens.
Runs when the user changes the selection (the selection a draw makes is reported as onAnnotation, not here). event.annotation, event.annotations and event.lens.

event.description: The lens under the probe, or null.

props.description: The scene, a structure reference: typically `{args.scene}`.

components.name: MikroSceneAnnotations
components.description: The scene's annotation layers, each card with its shapes and the selection in it. Placed inside a MikroScene.

props.description: Extra Tailwind classes appended to the element.
CSS height of the panel.

components.name: MikroSceneLayers
components.description: The scene's layers, as the scene page's Layers tab lists them. Placed inside a MikroScene.

props.description: Extra Tailwind classes appended to the element.
CSS height of the panel.

components.name: MikroSceneProbe
components.description: What the probe reads under the cursor. Placed inside a MikroScene.

props.description: Extra Tailwind classes appended to the element.
CSS height of the panel.

components.name: MikroSceneViewport
components.description: The scene's interactive view: draw, probe, navigate. Placed inside a MikroScene.

props.description: Open a shape's action card on a click or a draw. Defaults to false here: the blok decides what a shape does.
Extra Tailwind classes appended to the element.
CSS height of the viewport. Defaults to "32rem".
CSS minimum height of the viewport.
Show the Z and dimension sliders. Defaults to true.

components.name: TableColumns
components.description: Reads what a TableDataset's columns are. Draws nothing: a picker or a foreach reads the record.

props.description: Where the record is written: {"status", "loading", "ready", "failed", "empty", "stale", "error", "data"}. `data` is the list of columns, in order: {"name", "longName", "description", "dtype", "role", "unit", "axisType"}. Seed it in demo_state for the preview, which reads nothing.
Remove the record when this leaves the screen, instead of keeping it marked stale.
Only the columns of this role (or of any of these roles).
The table, a structure reference ({"object", "__identifier": "@mikro/tabledataset"}): typically `{args.table}`.

components.name: TableRows
components.description: Reads one page of a TableDataset's rows, filtered and sorted. Draws nothing: a foreach or a Table reads the record.

props.description: Where the record is written: {"status", "loading", "ready", "failed", "empty", "stale", "error", "data"}. `data` is {"rows": [{column: value}], "total"}: total counts every row the conditions keep. Seed it in demo_state for the preview, which reads nothing.
Remove the record when this leaves the screen, instead of keeping it marked stale.
The columns to read, by name. Defaults to every column.
Sort from the largest.
Rows per page. Defaults to 50, at most 1000.
Rows to skip: the page is offset / limit.
The column to sort by.
The table, a structure reference ({"object", "__identifier": "@mikro/tabledataset"}): typically `{args.table}`.
Conditions every row must meet: [{"column", "op", "value"}], op one of eq, ne, gt, gte, lt, lte, in, contains, isNull, notNull (default eq). "in" takes a list; "contains" matches text, ignoring case.
